meta.name: historical-interview-scripts
meta.description: 生成历史名人现代访谈短视频文案，通过古今反差与网络热梗的爆笑结合，创作具有传播力的虚构趣味内容

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成历史名人的现代访谈短视频文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想用古今反差和网络热梗制作爆笑历史短视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate modern interview scripts for historical figures
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create funny historical short videos with modern twists and internet memes

howto.what: Claude 会创作“历史名人现代访谈”短视频文案，按固定结构输出标题、嘉宾梗概、开场串词、访谈正文（提问＋回答）和结束互动；将网络热梗与历史人物特点结合，制造古今反差的喜剧效果。
howto.when: 当你提出创作历史人物访谈、趣味历史内容或短视频文案等需求时触发；用户指定人物时优先使用该人物素材。

say.text: 给李白、杜甫、苏轼写个现代职场访谈文案。
say.note: Claude 会按固定格式生成完整文案。

say.text: 写一期秦始皇、武则天、朱元璋的古代CEO管理访谈。
say.note: 会结合历史人物特点匹配热梗。

say.text: 把李清照和苏轼做成互怼访谈，用最近的热梗。
say.note: Claude 会设计跨界联动与爆笑回答。

howto.what_en: Claude creates short-video scripts for fictional modern talk-show interviews with historical figures, outputting title, guest summary, opening lines, interview dialogue, and closing interaction; it blends internet memes with historical traits for comedic contrast.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create historical-figure interviews, fun history content, or short-video scripts; if a specific figure is named, that figure's material is used first.

say_en.text: Write a modern workplace interview script for Li Bai, Du Fu, and Su Shi.
say_en.note: Claude will output a complete script in the fixed format.

say_en.text: Create an ancient-CEO management interview with Qin Shi Huang, Wu Zetian, and Zhu Yuanzhang.
say_en.note: It will match memes to each historical figure's traits.

say_en.text: Make Li Qingzhao and Su Shi roast each other using recent memes.
say_en.note: Claude will design a crossover with funny replies.
